### Solutions for the challenges you face

We’re inspired by positive patient outcomes. Over more than 80 years we’ve delivered
industry-leading technology, expert service, and specialized education to make a world of difference
in the lives of care providers and their patients.

[Neuro Solutions][103]
[Service & Support][104]
[Education][105]

### Products

We put clinicians first in the consideration and development of each solution we provide. We deliver
innovative and trusted solutions to screen, diagnose, and treat disorders affecting the brain and
neural pathways.

[Neuro Products][106]

### Service & Support

We are dedicated to providing unparalleled service to ensure a seamless experience, helping our
partners to deliver the highest standard of care and achieve the best possible patient outcomes.

[Service & Support][107]

### Education

We are committed to helping healthcare providers worldwide feel confident they can achieve the best
possible results. Natus Academies provide expert knowledge, clinical expertise and advanced
education – whatever your role, wherever you work.

[Neuro Training Academy][108]

monitoring in the emergency department (ED) and intensive care unit (ICU).

## Did you know?

Study results show that 1 out of 4 reusable EEG electrodes are contaminated with bacteria.

Insufficient cleaning of reusable EEG electrodes can lead to hospital-acquired infections (HAI). EEG
electrodes are classified as semi-critical devices. That means they are subject to high-level
disinfection requirements – the same as bronchoscopes and colonoscopes. 

To eliminate the potential risk of cross-contamination, single-use EEG electrodes could be
considered.

parts of the globe and there is no demographic, racial, and socioeconomic barriers. Auctores
facilitate the dissemination of research discoveries to the global community without restriction.
Thus, all articles published in Auctores journals are freely available online.

# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

Our commitment to restoring lives has been fundamental in making us a global leader in medical
technologies and providing innovative solutions in surgical, neurologic and regenerative care. At
Integra, we work with one central goal: to create healthier people, a healthier workplace and a
healthier world.

# ... because monitoring the brain matters!


The NeuroWave Team welcomes you. We are dedicated to developing innovative brain monitoring and drug
delivery medical devices, powered by state-of-the-art signal processing and control engineering
technologies. Our vision is to pioneer automation in anesthesia for improved and safer patient care.

NeuroWave is proud to offer the NeuroSENSE® Monitor, the latest generation of brain monitors for
patient-customized anesthesia and sedation delivery.

## FeaturedProduct

[Products»][6]

### [NeuroSENSE Monitor ][7]

The NeuroSENSE is a unique bilateral brain function monitor with simultaneous independent indices of
anesthetic effect for each side of the brain that respond instantaneously to changes in patient
state. This offers greater insight into the brain of anesthetized or sedated patients and assists
clinicians in detecting brain function asymmetry (due to, for example, unilateral pathology) and in
making optimal decisions for safer and improved patient care.

## Nihon Kohden Takes Pivotal Steps in Neurological Treatment Through the Acquisition of Ad‑Tech
## Medical Instrument Corporation

A Strategic Move to Further Solidify its Position in Comprehensive Epilepsy Diagnostics and Care

[View Press Release][21]

## Ad-Tech Medical Instrument Corporation

#### The World’s Leader

As the world leader, Ad-Tech's electrode devices are used in surgical cases for long-term EEG
monitoring*, brain mapping, SEEG, and brain stimulation of persons with intractable epilepsy and
other brain diseases/disorders.

**Long Term Monitoring: Device use is indicated for up to 29 days.*

#### Proprietary Design

Ad-Tech proprietary designs include subdural strip and grid electrodes, dual sided subdural
electrodes - depth electrodes - depth electrodes with micro contacts - foramen ovale electrodes -
intraoperative electrodes and spinal electrodes as well as related products including electrode
placement kits/accessory placement devices and brain biopsy needles.

#### Field Proven

Ad-Tech's devices feature design elements such as advanced materials and components as well as field
leading ease of use and connectivity, utilizing Ad-Tech's unique connection systems.

## Need More Information?

For product availability and a distributor in your country,
please contact Ad-Tech Medical directly.

[Contact Us][22]

## Brooke Winter

**Corporate Controller**

Brooke leads the finance department in month end close and financial statement preparation process,
streamlining it to enable timely decision making. She also works to strengthen and improve internal
controls, managing areas such as the cycle count program and coordination of annual audits. Brooke
is also responsible for budgeting and providing support and analysis to the leadership team in
alignment with the long-term growth strategy across all areas of the business. Before joining the
Ad-Tech team in 2021, Brooke held several roles in Finance at SC Johnson, supporting areas such as
Global Supply Chain, Global Internal Audit, and Global Consumer Brands. Education includes a
Bachelors of Business Degree with a double major in Accounting and Finance from the Wisconsin School
of Business. Brooke is also a Certified Public Accountant (CPA).

## Ad-Tech Medical Instrument Corporation

#### The World’s Leader

As the world leader, Ad-Tech's electrode devices are used in surgical cases for long-term EEG
monitoring*, brain mapping, SEEG, and brain stimulation of persons with intractable epilepsy and
other brain diseases/disorders.

**Long Term Monitoring: Device use is indicated for up to 29 days.*

#### Proprietary Design

Ad-Tech proprietary designs include subdural strip and grid electrodes, dual sided subdural
electrodes - depth electrodes - depth electrodes with micro contacts - foramen ovale electrodes -
intraoperative electrodes and spinal electrodes as well as related products including electrode
placement kits/accessory placement devices and brain biopsy needles.

#### Field Proven

Ad-Tech's devices feature design elements such as advanced materials and components as well as field
leading ease of use and connectivity, utilizing Ad-Tech's unique connection systems.

## Need More Information?

For product availability and a distributor in your country,
please contact Ad-Tech Medical directly.

## Brooke Winter

**Corporate Controller**

Brooke leads the finance department in month end close and financial statement preparation process,
streamlining it to enable timely decision making. She also works to strengthen and improve internal
controls, managing areas such as the cycle count program and coordination of annual audits. Brooke
is also responsible for budgeting and providing support and analysis to the leadership team in
alignment with the long-term growth strategy across all areas of the business. Before joining the
Ad-Tech team in 2021, Brooke held several roles in Finance at SC Johnson, supporting areas such as
Global Supply Chain, Global Internal Audit, and Global Consumer Brands. Education includes a
Bachelors of Business Degree with a double major in Accounting and Finance from the Wisconsin School
of Business. Brooke is also a Certified Public Accountant (CPA).

## Did you know?

Study results show that 1 out of 4 reusable EEG electrodes are contaminated with bacteria.

Insufficient cleaning of reusable EEG electrodes can lead to hospital-acquired infections (HAI). EEG
electrodes are classified as semi-critical devices. That means they are subject to high-level
disinfection requirements – the same as bronchoscopes and colonoscopes. 

To eliminate the potential risk of cross-contamination, single-use EEG electrodes could be
considered.

# Aims and scope

Auctores is an emerging international open access publisher aimed at development and rapid
dissemination of scientific knowledge to the global community without any restrictions. Auctores
encompasses journals on discipline of science, technology and engineering, publishes the work in a
manner that represents the highest standards and integrity.

Auctores Open aims to provide a service to authors and the research community by making as much
research available as possible, provided it meets AUCTORES’s high standards of research conduct and
ethical procedure and is approved after peer review.

# Aims and scope

Auctores is an emerging international open access publisher aimed at development and rapid
dissemination of scientific knowledge to the global community without any restrictions. Auctores
encompasses journals on discipline of science, technology and engineering, publishes the work in a
manner that represents the highest standards and integrity.

Auctores Open aims to provide a service to authors and the research community by making as much
research available as possible, provided it meets AUCTORES’s high standards of research conduct and
ethical procedure and is approved after peer review.

#### Auctores Story

We are supporting the aspirations of our communities by opening up the discovery process to the
whole world through openness, accessibility and transparency of research and data.
We encourage the academics all over the globe of various fields to get connected with Auctores and
publicize their findings. We follow rigorous standard peer review process and accept papers from all
parts of the globe and there is no demographic, racial, and socioeconomic barriers. Auctores
facilitate the dissemination of research discoveries to the global community without restriction.
Thus, all articles published in Auctores journals are freely available online.

expanding the boundaries of know-how.

quality articles and convey all scientists, researchers, academics to publish their research work
and make it impact globally. Auctores scrupulously emphasis on the advancement of knowledge in
critical areas through the delivery of innovative information. We continuously search to make
noteworthy assets that will serve research and technical community.

## Delivering trusted **diagnostics** and **health solutions** across professional and consumer care

BHR Biosynex builds on a strong heritage in diagnostics to support modern healthcare delivery across
clinical, community and home settings. We provide a carefully focused portfolio of trusted
point-of-care diagnostics and self-care health solutions that enable earlier decision-making,
improved access and better patient outcomes. Working in partnership with the NHS, pharmacies,
healthcare professionals and retail partners, we bridge professional and consumer care; supporting
integrated pathways, population health and the evolving role of diagnostics in everyday healthcare.

## Procedures ### Herniated Disc What is a herniated disc? Commonly referred to as a bulging disc or a slipped disc, herniated discs can be the root of your back pain. [Learn More][38] ### Myelopathy Myelopathy refers to the condition in which the patient suffers from a gradual loss of nerve function due to disorders of spine. It can be due to a functional disturbance or pathological change in the spinal cord. [Learn More][39] ### Spinal Stenosis Pain, tingling, weakness and instability – all these can result from stenosis, a narrowing of the canal in the vertebrae that can pinch and damage the spinal cord. [Learn More][40] [Learn More][41] [Learn More][42] [Learn More][43] ### Degenerative Spine Disorders Despite the name, it is not actually a disease. But that does not mean the pain it causes is less real. It can be very painful and can affect quality of life to a great extent. Disc degeneration is a normal part of aging, but for some individuals, it can cause severe and chronic pain. [Learn More][44] ### Vertebral Compression Fracture In a vertebral compression fracture, the vertebral bone collapses. This happens when the vertebral body is vertically compressed, and weight put on the vertebra exceeds what it can endure. Precision Monitoring

Advanced intraoperative monitoring that safeguards every patient and empowers surgical teams with
real-time insight.

# Advancing the standard of protection and precision

NeuroLogic provides real-time neurophysiologic monitoring during surgery to help surgeons reduce
risk and improve outcomes. Joint Commission accredited.

[Explore more →][16]

WHO WE ARE

## Continuous monitoring. Confident outcomes.

NeuroLogic delivers real-time neurophysiologic monitoring and physician review to help surgical
teams protect nerve function during surgery. Our on-site technologists are certified in IOM
techniques and our physician neurophysiologists provide live oversight and clinical consultation
when changes occur.

We support surgical teams nationwide with reliable scheduling, clear documentation, and
HIPAA-compliant handling of patient data.

[Learn more][17]

WHAT WE DO

## Real-time insights for safer, smarter surgeries.

## Patients

Our advanced intraoperative monitoring technologies let us run multiple specialized tests
simultaneously to protect nerve function during surgery. We deliver detailed, real-time data so
patients and surgical teams can act quickly if neural signals change

[Learn more →][18]

## Physicians

Surgeons and anesthesiologists rely on NeuroLogic for precise, timely neurophysiology input. Our
technicians and physician reviewers work with your surgical team to help avert injury and support
better outcomes.

[Learn more →][19]

## Facilities

Our team functions as an extension of your surgical and hospital staff, integrating seamlessly into
existing workflows to deliver high-quality monitoring for a wide range of procedures — including
neurosurgery, orthopedic, ENT, vascular, cardiothoracic, interventional radiology, and pain
management.

[Learn more →][20]

# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

[ Learn More About Y-Knotless™ Flex ][171]

# ... because monitoring the brain matters!


The NeuroWave Team welcomes you. We are dedicated to developing innovative brain monitoring and drug
delivery medical devices, powered by state-of-the-art signal processing and control engineering
technologies. Our vision is to pioneer automation in anesthesia for improved and safer patient care.

NeuroWave is proud to offer the NeuroSENSE® Monitor, the latest generation of brain monitors for
patient-customized anesthesia and sedation delivery.

## FeaturedProduct

[Products»][6]

### [NeuroSENSE Monitor ][7]

The NeuroSENSE is a unique bilateral brain function monitor with simultaneous independent indices of
anesthetic effect for each side of the brain that respond instantaneously to changes in patient
state. This offers greater insight into the brain of anesthetized or sedated patients and assists
clinicians in detecting brain function asymmetry (due to, for example, unilateral pathology) and in
making optimal decisions for safer and improved patient care.

## Nihon Kohden Takes Pivotal Steps in Neurological Treatment Through the Acquisition of Ad‑Tech
## Medical Instrument Corporation

A Strategic Move to Further Solidify its Position in Comprehensive Epilepsy Diagnostics and Care

[View Press Release][21]

## Ad-Tech Medical Instrument Corporation

#### The World’s Leader

As the world leader, Ad-Tech's electrode devices are used in surgical cases for long-term EEG
monitoring*, brain mapping, SEEG, and brain stimulation of persons with intractable epilepsy and
other brain diseases/disorders.

**Long Term Monitoring: Device use is indicated for up to 29 days.*

#### Proprietary Design

Ad-Tech proprietary designs include subdural strip and grid electrodes, dual sided subdural
electrodes - depth electrodes - depth electrodes with micro contacts - foramen ovale electrodes -
intraoperative electrodes and spinal electrodes as well as related products including electrode
placement kits/accessory placement devices and brain biopsy needles.

#### Field Proven

Ad-Tech's devices feature design elements such as advanced materials and components as well as field
leading ease of use and connectivity, utilizing Ad-Tech's unique connection systems.

## Need More Information?

For product availability and a distributor in your country,
please contact Ad-Tech Medical directly.

[Contact Us][22]


Your browser does not support HTML5 video.

## Brooke Winter

**Corporate Controller**

Brooke leads the finance department in month end close and financial statement preparation process,
streamlining it to enable timely decision making. She also works to strengthen and improve internal
controls, managing areas such as the cycle count program and coordination of annual audits. Brooke
is also responsible for budgeting and providing support and analysis to the leadership team in
alignment with the long-term growth strategy across all areas of the business. Before joining the
Ad-Tech team in 2021, Brooke held several roles in Finance at SC Johnson, supporting areas such as
Global Supply Chain, Global Internal Audit, and Global Consumer Brands. Education includes a
Bachelors of Business Degree with a double major in Accounting and Finance from the Wisconsin School
of Business. Brooke is also a Certified Public Accountant (CPA).

clinically relevant, cutting-edge products.

Our mission is to transform healthcare by creating in-house medical solutions across specialties,

## Procedures ### Herniated Disc What is a herniated disc? Commonly referred to as a bulging disc or a slipped disc, herniated discs can be the root of your back pain. [Learn More][38] ### Myelopathy Myelopathy refers to the condition in which the patient suffers from a gradual loss of nerve function due to disorders of spine. It can be due to a functional disturbance or pathological change in the spinal cord. [Learn More][39] ### Spinal Stenosis Pain, tingling, weakness and instability – all these can result from stenosis, a narrowing of the canal in the vertebrae that can pinch and damage the spinal cord. [Learn More][40] [Learn More][41] [Learn More][42] [Learn More][43] ### Degenerative Spine Disorders Despite the name, it is not actually a disease. But that does not mean the pain it causes is less real. It can be very painful and can affect quality of life to a great extent. Disc degeneration is a normal part of aging, but for some individuals, it can cause severe and chronic pain. [Learn More][44] ### Vertebral Compression Fracture In a vertebral compression fracture, the vertebral bone collapses. This happens when the vertebral body is vertically compressed, and weight put on the vertebra exceeds what it can endure. Precision Monitoring

Advanced intraoperative monitoring that safeguards every patient and empowers surgical teams with

# Advancing the standard of protection and precision

NeuroLogic provides real-time neurophysiologic monitoring during surgery to help surgeons reduce
risk and improve outcomes. Joint Commission accredited.

[Explore more →][16]

WHO WE ARE

## Continuous monitoring. Confident outcomes.

NeuroLogic delivers real-time neurophysiologic monitoring and physician review to help surgical
teams protect nerve function during surgery. Our on-site technologists are certified in IOM

Partners on July 1, 2026 through Vanderbilt Health.

**Her new practice location is:**
1616 West Main, 2nd Floor
Lebanon, TN 37087
Phone: 615-467-4633 or 615-875-5100
Fax: 615-343-9463

We apologize for the last-minute notification. Please know we have been working hard to ensure there

ways:

**Telephone request:** 615-239-2018
**Website request:** [https://www.ouradvancedhealth.com][3]
**Written request:**
Records Request
C/O Advanced Health
3024 Business Park Circle
Goodlettsville, TN 37072

our family.
If you would like to seek neurosurgical care through another location or provider, please contact
Dr. Zywicke for a referral.

**Effective June 12th, 2026**

Margaret MacGregor

### Programa de Aceleración Agrifoodtech

El Programa de Aceleración AgriFoodTech es una iniciativa diseñada para fortalecer el modelo de
innovación tecnológica, transformación digital, internacionalización o atracción de inversión de
pequeñas y medianas empresas o startups con potencial de exportación de Costa Rica.

[ Ver más ][52]
Desarrollo de Habilidades Abierto

### IMPULSA 2026 – Programa de formación para mujeres empresarias

IMPULSA 2026 busca fortalecer las capacidades empresariales de mujeres en áreas estratégicas como
negocios, comunicación estratégica, innovación, sostenibilidad, finanzas, gestión de proyectos y
negociación.

[ Ver más ][53]
Acompañamiento empresarial Abierto

### Programa Integra

El Programa Nacional de Desarrollo de Suplidores tiene como objetivo fortalecer las capacidades de
los suplidores nacionales para cerrar brechas en la oferta local. Para ello, articula recursos
existentes y herramientas diseñadas específicamente para el programa, integrando tecnologías
emergentes y metodologías ágiles, con el fin de generar un impacto tangible en las Cadenas Globales
de Valor.

[ Ver más ][54]
Financiamiento Abierto

### Abordaje Investigación y Desarrollo

En alianza con Sistema Banca para el Desarrollo y el INA, PROCOMER se apoyará a las empresas en
acciones puntuales relacionadas a investigación y desarrollo, un abordaje en el marco del Programa
INTEGRA, en cual, a través de innovación aplicada, empresas suplidoras podrán transformar desafíos
productivos reales de en soluciones innovadoras con alto potencial de impacto productivo y
generación de valor agregado.
